ctx.x: What were the Hardy Brothers first names?

Wesley Hardy was one, and I can't think of the other guy's name. Wesley was the thin one, then there's a fat one we called Horse. I never did know Horse's name. But these were the two Hardy Brothers. But they weren't the leaders of the band. The leader of the band was Coleridge Davis, piano player. He led the band and did the arrangements. But it was the Hardy Brothers band, but Coleridge, he seemed
to handle that money and do everything else. He did the hiring and firing, so -- but they use that name, the Hardy Brothers.
